description: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault (2015 Inc. / EA 2002, retail v1.00 data, via OpenMoHAA source port)
long: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault is a World War II first-person shooter casting the player as a US Army Ranger across campaigns including the Normandy landings. Players complete scripted military missions involving infiltration, sabotage and large-scale firefights. It is celebrated for its cinematic D-Day beach assault and also offers competitive multiplayer modes.
